name: balseraphs_adept
description: a Balseraph Adept, a jester mage: a purple, gold and green harlequin hood with floppy points tipped with gold bells, a white half-mask, red-orange hair, a long purple robe with gold trim and green-and-gold diamonds, a gold rope belt, a brown leather satchel on a strap at his screen-left hip, brown boots, a tall wooden staff topped with a glowing yellow crystal in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side, and his RIGHT hand an empty fist at his waist on the screen-left side
hands: the crystal-topped staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist on the screen-left side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut behind the white half-mask, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the crystal staff arm thrown up and out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the crystal-topped staff dipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the crystal-topped staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the staff tilted with its crystal top resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the crystal staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the jester hood still on his head; the crystal-topped staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the satchel beside his hip
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the hood's points and bells settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, the white half-mask on his face, the crystal-topped staff on the ground beside him, its crystal dimmed
